pre: f=/tmp/tipc-sock.$$; python3 -c 'import socket as s, sys, threading as th, time; r = s.socket(s.AF_TIPC, s.SOCK_RDM); r.bind((s.TIPC_ADDR_NAMESEQ, 1000, 1, 1, s.TIPC_NODE_SCOPE)); l = s.socket(s.AF_TIPC, s.SOCK_STREAM); l.bind((s.TIPC_ADDR_NAME, 2000, 1, 0)); l.listen(1); c = s.socket(s.AF_TIPC, s.SOCK_STREAM); t = th.Thread(target=c.connect, args=((s.TIPC_ADDR_NAME, 2000, 1, 0),)); t.start(); a, _ = l.accept(); t.join(); open(sys.argv[1], "w").close(); time.sleep(30)' "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1 & for i in $(seq 50); do [ -e "$f" ] && rm -f "$f" && exit 0; sleep 0.1; done; exit 1
